name: Bin Weixin
source:
"...I have a matter of great importance to discuss."

Bin Weixin is a high-ranking member of the Qingyun Society, and one of [url=/c7183]Liu Haojun[/url]'s top lieutenants. He acts as the Society's advisor. A Waijia master known as the "Hundred-Handed Weaver" for his skill, speed and precision with throwing knives and tools of assassination.

One of the five responsible for [url=/c7182]Kong Ruili[/url]'s rape and murder.
